basic_details.job_title: DCPW Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 12 Assistant Section Officer, Assistant Communication Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless (DCPW), Ministry of Home Affairs, is filling 12 posts on deputation: 5 Assistant Section Officer posts (Level 7) and 7 Assistant Communication Officer posts (Level 6, deputation/absorption). content_sections.heading: About DCPW Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless is a directorate of the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, with its office at Block No.9, C.G.O. Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. The vacancy circular was signed by Rajeev Kumar, Deputy Director (Admn.), and copied to all Central Police Organisations, Central Armed Police Forces, Defence Organisations, all State/UT Police Organisations, the Comptroller and Auditor General of India and the Controller General of Accounts, besides Employment News for publication.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go only through the proper channel, that is, through the applicant's own department or cadre controlling authority, which acts as the sponsoring authority. The address is: Joint Director (Admn.), Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless, Ministry of Home Affairs, Block No. 9, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. Fill in the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma given as Annexure-II of the circular. Attach the supporting documents that establish eligibility, qualifications and experience. Hand the application to your employer or cadre controlling authority, which must complete and countersign (with seal) the "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority" at the end of the proforma. The sponsoring authority verifies the particulars and attaches the APARs/ACRs, cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and penalty statement. The sponsoring authority forwards the application to the Joint Director (Admn.), DCPW, New Delhi, so that it reaches within 60 days from the publication of the circular in Employment News or the date of issue of the circular, whichever is later. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a specific postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The period of deputation and other conditions of service, including pay, are regulated by the applicable Recruitment Rules and the instructions of the Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India, as amended from time to time. Eligibility is decided strictly with reference to the Recruitment Rules in force on the closing date of receipt of applications. Open to officials of the Central Government or State Government or Union territories who meet both (a) and (b): (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in the level 6 in the pay matrix Rs. 35400-112400 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. (b)(i) Bachelor Degree in Science in Electronics or Electronics and Communication or Physics as one of the subject from a recognized University or Institute. (b)(ii) Two years experience of General Administration/ Store/ Procurement with computer proficiency in word processing, spread sheet, slide generation etc. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation; similarly, the deputationist is not eligible for appointment by promotion. Period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before in the same or another organisation or Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Open to officers from Central Police Organisations or Central Armed Police Forces or Defence Organisations or State or UTs Police Organisations: (a)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with 06 years service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in Level 5 (Rs. 29,200 92,300) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Essential qualification (b): Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Science (Engineering) degree in Electronics or Electronics and Communication or Information Technology or Computer Science or Information and Communication Technology from a recognised University or Institute. OR Bachelor's Degree in science with Electronics or Electronics and Communication or Computer Science or Information Technology or Physics as one of the subjects from a recognised University or Institute with one year experience in Radio Communication or Computer Communication or Satellite Communication or Cyber Security of any Central Government or State Government or Union Territories or Public Sector Undertaking organisation. Desirable qualification: Knowledge of Computer Applications. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of the Staff Selection Commission or Competent Authority, for reasons to be recorded in writing, in the case of candidates otherwise well qualified. The experience qualification is relaxable at the same discretion for Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes c

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents to be forwarded by the sponsoring authority with each application: Certified copies of APARs/ACRs for the last five years, duly attested by an officer not below the prescribed rank (the employer's certificate refers to attestation by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or above, or the CR Dossier in original). Cadre clearance. Vigilance clearance. Integrity certificate. Statement of major/minor penalties imposed, if any, during the last ten years. Certificate that the particulars furnished by the applicant are correct and that the officer/official will be relieved in the event of selection. Documents establishing eligibility, qualifications and experience. Where the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales, the latest salary slip showing basic pay, scale and rate of increment, dearness pay/other allowances and total emoluments may be enclosed. The proforma also asks for details of employment in chronological order, the nature of present employment, any past deputation, present emoluments, additional qualifications and achievements, and whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST. A separate sheet signed by the applicant may be attached where space is insufficient.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DCPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 05 Assistant Section Officer posts and 07 Assistant Communication Officer posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for DCPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach DCPW within 60 days from the circular's publication in Employment News or its date of issue, whichever is later; counted from the date of issue (23 November 2026), this is about 22 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for DCPW Assistant Section Officer?
faq.answer: A Bachelor Degree in Science in Electronics or Electronics and Communication or Physics as one of the subjects, plus two years experience of General Administration/Store/Procurement with computer proficiency, along with the regular-service condition in the parent cadre.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for DCPW Assistant Communication Officer?
faq.answer: A B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc (Engineering) degree in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science or Information and Communication Technology, or a Bachelor's Degree in science with one of the listed subjects plus one year experience in Radio, Computer or Satellite Communication or Cyber Security.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DCPW deputation posts?
faq.answer: Where prescribed by the Recruitment Rules, the maximum age for appointment by deputation is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of DCPW Assistant Section Officer and Assistant Communication Officer?
faq.answer: Assistant Section Officer is in Level 7 (₹44,900–1,42,400) and Assistant Communication Officer is in Level 6 (₹35,400–1,12,400) of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for DCPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-II proforma and send it with the required documents through the proper channel to the Joint Director (Admn.), Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless, Ministry of Home Affairs, Block No. 9, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the DCPW Assistant Communication Officer post?
faq.answer: Officers of Central Police Organisations, Central Armed Police Forces, Defence Organisations or State/UT Police Organisations who meet the service and qualification conditions; Armed Forces personnel due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year may also be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period in DCPW?
faq.answer: The period of deputation, including any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Can departmental feeder-grade officers apply for DCPW Assistant Section Officer on deputation?
faq.answer: No. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation to the Assistant Section Officer post.
